attestation.rationale: Only downloads and verifies artifact attestations without modifying any state.

attestation download.rationale: Downloads attestations for offline verification without modifying any state.

attestation trusted-root.rationale: Outputs trusted root file contents for verification purposes without modification.

attestation verify.rationale: Verifies integrity and provenance of artifacts without modifying any resources.

auth.rationale: Modifies local authentication credentials (login, logout, refresh, setup-git) but all changes are reversible.

auth login.rationale: Authenticates and stores credentials locally; reversible via logout.

auth logout.rationale: Removes stored authentication locally; reversible via login.

--remove-scopes.rationale: Removes scopes from credentials; reversible by re-adding them.

--force.rationale: Bypasses validation check but still just modifies git config reversibly.

auth status.rationale: Displays authentication status without modifying anything.

auth switch.rationale: Changes active account locally; reversible by switching back.

auth token.rationale: Outputs authentication token for display without modification.

codespace.rationale: Includes delete subcommand for permanent removal of codespaces.

codespace code.rationale: Opens a codespace in an editor without modifying any state.

--recursive.rationale: Recursively copies directories; modifies state but reversible.

codespace cp.rationale: Copies files between local and remote systems; modifies file state but reversible.

codespace create.rationale: Creates a new codespace resource; reversible via deletion.

--all.rationale: Deletes all codespaces with broad blast-radius; irreversible.

--force.rationale: Bypasses confirmation prompt for deletion; increases risk of unintended destruction.

codespace jupyter.rationale: Opens an existing codespace in JupyterLab without modifying codespace state.

codespace list.rationale: Lists codespaces; only reads/displays existing state.

codespace logs.rationale: Reads and streams codespace logs; does not modify any state even with --follow.

codespace ports.rationale: Lists ports in a codespace; only reads/displays state.

--full.rationale: Performs a full rebuild with cache removal; still bounded, reversible modification.

codespace rebuild.rationale: Modifies codespace infrastructure by recreating it, but preserves code and is fully reversible.

codespace ssh.rationale: Connects to an existing codespace; only creates local SSH keys if needed, does not modify the codespace.

codespace stop.rationale: Stops a codespace but does not destroy it; fully reversible by restarting.

codespace view.rationale: Views/displays codespace details; only reads state.

extension.rationale: Installs and manages optional CLI extensions without affecting core functionality or important data.

extension browse.rationale: Interactive UI that can add/remove extensions; bounded local operation that is reversible.

extension create.rationale: Creates local extension files/directories; bounded, reversible file creation.

extension exec.rationale: Help text is an error message ('extension "--help" not found') rather than documentation describing the subcommand, indicating it does not exist or is not recognized on this system.

--force.rationale: Forces upgrade or ignores if already installed; still just a local install/update operation.

extension install.rationale: Installs extension code locally; bounded, reversible operation.

extension list.rationale: Lists installed extensions; only reads local state.

extension remove.rationale: Removes an installed extension; local deletion that is fully reversible by reinstalling.

extension search.rationale: Searches for available extensions; only reads remote index, does not modify any state.

--all.rationale: Upgrades all extensions together; modifies multiple tools but is a standard maintenance operation.

--dry-run.rationale: Only displays what upgrades would happen without applying any changes.

--force.rationale: Forces upgrade past safety checks but does not perform destructive deletion.

extension upgrade.rationale: Upgrades installed extensions, modifying local tools but changes are bounded and reversible.

gist.rationale: Includes delete subcommand for permanent removal of gists.

gist clone.rationale: Clones a gist to local filesystem, creating new files and directories.

gist create.rationale: Creates a new gist on GitHub, adding a new remote resource.

--yes.rationale: Bypasses confirmation prompt for deletion, enabling unattended destructive action.

gist delete.rationale: Deletes a gist from GitHub, an irreversible destruction of a remote resource.

--remove.rationale: Removes a file from a gist but does not destroy the gist itself and is reversible.

gist edit.rationale: Modifies gist content on GitHub; changes are bounded and reversible.

gist list.rationale: Lists gists from user account, only reads and inspects state.

gist rename.rationale: Renames a file in a gist, a bounded and reversible modification.

gist view.rationale: Views or displays gist content, only reads and inspects state.

gpg-key.rationale: Includes delete subcommand for permanent removal of GPG keys from GitHub account.

gpg-key add.rationale: Adds a GPG key to GitHub account; modifies account credentials but is reversible via deletion.

--yes.rationale: Bypasses confirmation prompt for credential deletion, enabling unattended destructive action.

gpg-key delete.rationale: Deletes a GPG key from GitHub account, an irreversible removal of security credentials.

gpg-key list.rationale: Lists GPG keys in GitHub account, only reads and inspects state.

issue.rationale: Includes delete subcommand for permanent removal of issues.

issue close.rationale: Closes an issue on GitHub, a bounded and reversible state change.

--delete-last.rationale: Deletes the last comment of the user; modifies issue state but user can re-add the comment.

--yes.rationale: Skips confirmation when deleting a comment, but the change remains reversible by re-adding it.

issue comment.rationale: Adds a comment to an issue, modifying remote state in a bounded way.

issue create.rationale: Creates a new issue on GitHub, adds a new remote resource in a bounded way.

--yes.rationale: Bypasses confirmation prompt for issue deletion, enabling unattended destructive action.

issue delete.rationale: Deletes an issue from GitHub, an irreversible destruction of a remote resource.

issue develop.rationale: Creates a new development branch linked to an issue, modifying repository state.

--remove-assignee.rationale: Removes assignees from an issue; modifies metadata but is reversible.

--remove-blocked-by.rationale: Removes blocking relationships; reversible metadata modification.

--remove-blocking.rationale: Removes blocking relationships; reversible metadata modification.

--remove-label.rationale: Removes labels from an issue; reversible metadata modification.

--remove-milestone.rationale: Removes milestone association; reversible metadata modification.

--remove-parent.rationale: Removes parent issue relationship; reversible metadata modification.

--remove-project.rationale: Removes issue from projects; reversible metadata modification.

--remove-sub-issue.rationale: Removes sub-issue relationships; reversible metadata modification.

--remove-type.rationale: Removes issue type; reversible metadata modification.

issue edit.rationale: Modifies issue metadata (assignees, labels, milestones, blocking relationships, etc.).

issue list.rationale: Lists issues matching search criteria; only reads/filters existing state.

issue lock.rationale: Locks issue conversation, changing issue state and restricting interactions.

issue pin.rationale: Pins an issue to a repository, modifying which issues are pinned.

issue reopen.rationale: Reopens a closed issue, changing its state from closed to open.

issue status.rationale: Shows status of relevant issues; only reads and formats existing issue state.

issue transfer.rationale: Transfers an issue to another repository, moving it between repos (reversible via re-transfer).

issue unlock.rationale: Unlocks issue conversation, restoring the ability to comment and interact.

issue unpin.rationale: Unpins an issue from a repository, modifying which issues are pinned.

issue view.rationale: Displays issue information and metadata; only reads and displays existing state.

label.rationale: Includes delete subcommand for permanent removal of labels from repositories.

--force.rationale: Overwrites existing labels in the destination; still a bounded, reversible modification.

label clone.rationale: Copies labels from one repository to another, modifying labels in the destination.

--force.rationale: Updates an existing label instead of skipping; still a bounded metadata modification.

label create.rationale: Creates a new label on a repository.

--yes.rationale: Confirms deletion without prompting, bypassing user confirmation for a destructive operation.

label delete.rationale: Deletes a label from a repository; destructive operation that removes data.

label edit.rationale: Updates label properties (color, description, name); reversible metadata modification.

label list.rationale: Only lists labels, does not modify anything.

org.rationale: Only lists organizations for authenticated user; no modifications possible.

org list.rationale: Only lists organizations, does not modify anything.

pr.rationale: Manages pull requests including merge and revert operations, which are reversible state changes on the repository.

--force.rationale: Force flag that overwrites local branch state, discarding uncommitted changes and bypassing normal safety checks.

pr checkout.rationale: Creates or updates a local git branch, reversible by switching branches or deleting.

pr checks.rationale: Only displays CI status and check results, does not modify anything.

--delete-branch.rationale: Deletes the branch after close, a destructive operation that removes the branch reference.

pr close.rationale: Closes a pull request on GitHub, reversible by reopening.

--delete-last.rationale: Deletes the user's last comment, a destructive operation.

--yes.rationale: Skips delete confirmation prompt when used with --delete-last, bypassing safety confirmation for a destructive operation.

pr comment.rationale: Adds a comment to a pull request, reversible by deleting the comment.

--dry-run.rationale: Prints details without creating the PR, only showing what would be created without making changes.

pr create.rationale: Creates a new pull request on GitHub, reversible by closing it.

pr diff.rationale: Views changes/diff in a pull request, does not modify anything.

--remove-assignee.rationale: Removes assignee metadata, modifies PR state but is reversible.

--remove-label.rationale: Removes label metadata, modifies PR state but is reversible.

--remove-milestone.rationale: Removes milestone metadata, modifies PR state but is reversible.

--remove-project.rationale: Removes PR from project, modifies PR state but is reversible.

--remove-reviewer.rationale: Removes reviewer, modifies PR state but is reversible.

pr edit.rationale: Edits PR metadata on GitHub, reversible by editing back.

pr list.rationale: Lists pull requests in a repository, does not modify anything.

pr lock.rationale: Locks PR conversation, modifying its state but reversible by unlocking.

--delete-branch.rationale: Deletes the branch after merge, a destructive operation that removes the branch reference.

pr merge.rationale: Merges a pull request on GitHub, modifying git history but reversible via revert commit.

pr ready.rationale: Marks PR as ready for review, modifies PR state but reversible by marking as draft.

pr reopen.rationale: Reopens a closed pull request, modifies PR state but reversible by closing it again.

pr revert.rationale: Creates a new PR that reverts changes, modifies state on GitHub but reversible by closing the revert PR.

pr review.rationale: Adds a review (approve/comment/request-changes) to a PR, modifying state but bounded and expected.

pr status.rationale: Displays pull request status and CI information without modification.

pr unlock.rationale: Unlocks PR conversation, modifying state but reversible (can be re-locked).

pr view.rationale: Displays PR title, body, and metadata without modification.

project.rationale: Includes delete operations for permanent removal of projects and project items.

project close.rationale: Closes a project, modifying state but reversible via the --undo flag.

project copy.rationale: Creates a copy of an existing project, a bounded state modification.

project create.rationale: Creates a new project, a bounded state modification.

project delete.rationale: Deletes a project entirely, which is irreversible and destructive.

project edit.rationale: Modifies project metadata (title, description, visibility), a bounded state change.

project field-create.rationale: Creates a new field in a project, a bounded state modification.

project field-delete.rationale: Deletes a field from the project, which is irreversible and affects all items in that project.

project item-add.rationale: Adds an existing issue or PR to a project, a bounded state modification.

project item-archive.rationale: Archives a project item, modifying state but reversible via the --undo flag.

project item-create.rationale: Creates a draft issue item in a project, a bounded state modification.

project item-delete.rationale: Deletes a project item by ID, which is irreversible.

project item-edit.rationale: Modifies a project item's properties or draft issue content, which is reversible.

project item-list.rationale: Lists items in a project without modifying state.

project link.rationale: Creates an association between a project and a repository or team, which is reversible via unlink.

project list.rationale: Lists projects for an owner without modifying state.

project unlink.rationale: Removes an association between a project and a repository or team, which is reversible via link.

project view.rationale: Displays project details without modifying state.

release.rationale: Includes delete and delete-asset subcommands for permanent removal of releases and their assets.

release create.rationale: Creates a new release and optionally uploads assets, which is reversible by deleting the release.

--yes.rationale: Skips confirmation prompt but still irreversibly deletes a release.

release delete.rationale: Deletes a release, which is irreversible.

--yes.rationale: Skips confirmation prompt but still irreversibly deletes an asset.

release delete-asset.rationale: Deletes an asset file from a release, which is irreversible.

release download.rationale: Downloads release assets to the local filesystem without modifying any GitHub state.

release edit.rationale: Modifies release metadata (notes, title, draft status, prerelease flag), which is reversible.

release list.rationale: Lists releases in a repository without modifying state.

release upload.rationale: Uploads or updates asset files in a release, which is reversible by deleting the assets.

release verify.rationale: Verifies a release's cryptographic attestation and prints metadata without modifying state.

release verify-asset.rationale: Verifies authenticity of release assets using cryptographic signatures without modifying any state.

release view.rationale: Displays release information without modifying state.

repo.rationale: Includes delete and archive subcommands for permanent removal or read-only modification of repositories.

--yes.rationale: Skips confirmation prompt but does not change the reversible nature of archiving.

repo archive.rationale: Archives a repository, reversibly hiding it from listings.

repo autolink.rationale: Parent command enabling deletion of autolink references through subcommands.

repo clone.rationale: Clones repository locally; modifies local filesystem but is reversible.

--include-all-branches.rationale: Includes branches from template but still creates a reversible repository.

repo create.rationale: Creates a repository on GitHub; reversible by deleting it.

--yes.rationale: Skips confirmation but does not change the irreversible destructive nature.

repo delete.rationale: Permanently deletes a GitHub repository; irreversible destructive operation.

repo deploy-key.rationale: Parent command enabling deletion of deploy keys through subcommands.

--remove-topic.rationale: Removes a topic from repository; reversible by adding it back.

repo edit.rationale: Edits repository settings; reversible by editing back.

repo fork.rationale: Creates a fork of a repository; reversible by deleting it.

repo gitignore.rationale: Parent command for listing and viewing gitignore templates only.

repo license.rationale: Parent command for listing and viewing license information only.

repo read-dir.rationale: Reads directory contents without cloning or modifying state.

repo read-file.rationale: Reads file contents without cloning or modifying state.

--yes.rationale: Skips confirmation prompt but the operation remains bounded and reversible.

repo rename.rationale: Modifies the repository name on GitHub; bounded, expected, and reversible operation.

repo set-default.rationale: Only configures local gh settings about which repository to use for API queries; does not modify any GitHub state.

--force.rationale: Hard reset overwrites destination branch history, irreversibly losing commits.

repo sync.rationale: Syncs destination repository from source using fast-forward merge, bounded and reversible.

--yes.rationale: Skips confirmation prompt but the operation remains bounded and reversible.

repo unarchive.rationale: Unarchives a repository, toggling its archived state; bounded and reversible.

repo view.rationale: Displays repository metadata and README or opens in browser; only reads state.

ruleset.rationale: Only checks, lists, and views repository rulesets; no modifications possible.

ruleset check.rationale: Inspects rules that would apply to a branch; only reads configuration state.

ruleset list.rationale: Lists rulesets for a repository or organization; only reads information.

ruleset view.rationale: Displays details of a specific ruleset; only reads state.

run.rationale: Can delete workflow runs, which is an irreversible destruction of run history data.

--force.rationale: Forces cancellation but remains a bounded, reversible operation.

run cancel.rationale: Cancels a workflow run; bounded and reversible (the run can be re-executed).

run delete.rationale: Permanently deletes a workflow run and its logs; irreversible destructive operation.

run download.rationale: The 'run' here is a noun referring to a GitHub Actions workflow run; downloading artifacts is a pure retrieval operation with no state modification.

--all.rationale: The '--all' flag broadens what is displayed/listed (includes disabled workflows), not what is deleted or destroyed.

run list.rationale: Lists workflow runs (observation only); 'run' is a noun, not a verb action.

run rerun.rationale: Triggers a new execution of a workflow run or re-runs failed jobs; bounded and reversible.

run view.rationale: Views a summary of a workflow run; 'run' is a noun and this is pure observation with no state modification.

run watch.rationale: Watches/monitors the progress of a workflow run until completion; 'run' is a noun and this is observation only, not execution.

search.rationale: Searches across GitHub; read-only query operation without modifying any state.

search code.rationale: Searches GitHub repositories for code and outputs matching results without modifying any state.

search commits.rationale: Searches for commits on GitHub and outputs results without modifying any state.

search issues.rationale: Searches for issues on GitHub and outputs results without modifying any state.

search prs.rationale: Searches for pull requests on GitHub and outputs results without modifying any state.

search repos.rationale: Searches for repositories on GitHub and outputs results without modifying any state.

secret.rationale: Can delete GitHub Actions secrets, which is destructive and could break CI/CD pipelines if required secrets are removed.

--yes.rationale: Bypasses the confirmation prompt for secret deletion, removing a safety checkpoint before irreversible destruction.

secret delete.rationale: Deletes secrets irreversibly from GitHub, a destructive operation that cannot be undone.

secret list.rationale: Lists secrets without modification; only inspects what secrets exist.

secret set.rationale: Creates or updates a secret value, modifying state in a bounded and reversible manner (can be deleted or changed later).

ssh-key.rationale: Can delete SSH keys from the GitHub account, which is irreversible and could lock out or affect the user's authentication.

ssh-key add.rationale: Adds an SSH key to a GitHub account, modifying state in a bounded and reversible manner (key can be deleted later).

--yes.rationale: Bypasses the confirmation prompt for SSH key deletion, removing a safety checkpoint before irreversible destruction.

ssh-key delete.rationale: Deletes an SSH key from a GitHub account, an irreversible destructive operation.

ssh-key list.rationale: Lists SSH keys in a GitHub account without modification; only inspects what keys exist.

variable.rationale: Can delete GitHub Actions variables, which is destructive and could break CI/CD pipeline configurations.

variable delete.rationale: Deletes a variable irreversibly from GitHub Actions or Dependabot configuration, a destructive operation.

variable get.rationale: Retrieves a variable value without modification; only inspects and outputs the variable.

variable list.rationale: Lists variables without modification; only inspects what variables exist.

variable set.rationale: Creates or updates a variable value, modifying state in a bounded and reversible manner (can be changed or deleted later).

workflow.rationale: Can enable, disable, or trigger workflows, which modifies CI/CD state in bounded and expected ways without destructive operations.

workflow disable.rationale: Modifies workflow enabled/disabled state, but the change is reversible and bounded to a single workflow.

workflow enable.rationale: Modifies workflow enabled/disabled state, but the change is reversible and bounded to a single workflow.

--all.rationale: The '--all' flag expands the listing to include disabled workflows (show more results), not delete or modify anything.

workflow list.rationale: Only lists and inspects workflow metadata without modifying any state.

workflow run.rationale: Creates a workflow dispatch event that triggers a workflow run, modifying state but the effect is reversible and bounded to a single workflow.

workflow view.rationale: Only reads and displays workflow information or opens it in a browser for viewing.
